name: blyxtorch
description: Train neural networks and simulate differentiable Ry/CNOT circuits in Blyx. Includes native trainers, editable projects and OpenQASM 3 export.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with BlyxTorch
walkthroughs.description: Train neural networks and simulate differentiable Ry/CNOT circuits in Blyx. Includes native trainers, editable projects and OpenQASM 3 export.

steps.title: Fit your first sensor model
steps.description:
Create a file ending in .blyx. Type bt-sensor, choose the completion and run Blyx: Run File.
[Open the project guide](https://www.blyx-lang.space/packages/blyxtorch#projects)

steps.title: Train and evaluate a classifier
steps.description:
Extract the starter and open BlyxTorch.code-workspace. Choose Terminal → Run Task → BlyxTorch: Evaluate print queue.
[Download both projects](https://github.com/Rahulchaube1/blyxtorch/releases/download/v0.5.0/blyxtorch-projects-0.5.0.zip)

steps.title: Differentiate a quantum circuit
steps.description:
Extract the starter, open its workspace and run **BlyxTorch: Fit a quantum circuit**.
[Open the experiment](https://www.blyx-lang.space/articles/training-in-factors)
